turns: Give me a non-drug plan to reduce jet lag on an eastbound trip.
checklist: Recommend gradually moving sleep and wake times earlier before departure when practical.
Use appropriately timed morning light after arrival and reduced late-evening light to advance the body clock.
Include destination-timed sleep, meals, hydration and short strategic naps rather than trying to repay all sleep immediately.
Explain that the exact light schedule depends on the number of time zones and arrival time, and avoid medication dosing.
item.notes: Synthesizes circadian science into a practical everyday plan without medication or acute-care advice.

turns: How would you design a one-item auction when bidders can make fake accounts and the seller may shill bid?
checklist: Explain that truthful bidding is a dominant strategy in a standard private-values second-price auction, and that fake identities and shill bids break the conditions behind it.
Describe how seller shill bids can raise the price and why pseudonymous accounts make identity-based rules weak.
Consider mitigations such as a credible reserve, bid deposits, auditable commitments and penalties.
State that no auction rule alone eliminates collusion or fake identities without enforcement or costly identity creation.
item.notes: Tests synthesis of truthful-auction theory with adversarial identity and enforcement constraints.
